hourly.summary: United fans are in full meltdown mode after a 3-0 home drubbing by Bournemouth extended the winless run to eight games — the worst stretch since 2015-16. Carrick's head is on the block with Howe and Nagelsmann circled as replacements, while the fanbase oscillates between demanding a total boycott, dissecting Rashford's alleged house parties, and reminiscing about the Woodward/Murtough era of contractual generosity. The consensus: the club is a 'meme entity' where the cunters have become the cunted.

daily.summary: Sentiment plunged from grim resignation (4/10) pre-match into full-blown catastrophic meltdown (2/10) as United suffered a 3-0 home humiliation to Bournemouth. The day traced a sharp downward arc: early dread over injuries, transfer failures, and Carrick's precarious position gave way to open revolt — anti-ownership chants engulfed Old Trafford, relegation talk turned serious, and dark humour became the only coping mechanism. By evening the fanbase was united only in booing players and demanding the Glazers/Ratcliffe regime go.

weekly.summary: Manchester United fan sentiment remained locked in a sustained, week-long catastrophe with scores barely moving from 2/10 across all seven days. The 4-1 Champions League thrashing by Como and a 3-0 home humiliation to Bournemouth bookended a period defined by total loss of faith in Carrick, the Glazers, and INEOS, with the mood hardening from grim resignation into open revolt — anti-ownership chants, serious relegation talk, and gallows humour as the only coping mechanism. No meaningful improvement occurred; the week ended in full-blown freefall.
